biotools.summary: The RTK Database provides curated information on Receptor Tyrosine Kinase (RTK) domains, including structural data, ligand-binding properties, and sequence information. It leverages experimentally-resolved structures and AlphaFold2 models to explore domain architecture and evolutionary relationships within the RTK superfamily.
